name: RBI Master Direction on relief measures in areas affected by natural calamities
notes: Standing rule: after a state declares a calamity and the SLBC/DCC acts (crop loss 33% or more), banks reschedule loans with at least one year of moratorium and give fresh loans. Expect reported credit to be held up by rescheduling in treated districts; earlier circulars set similar rules before 2017

name: Andhra Pradesh farm loan waiver (about Rs 43000 crore)
notes: Covers farm and gold loans, women's SHG loans and weavers' loans, Rs 1.5 lakh per family ceiling; decided three months before Hudhud, paid in instalments afterwards, so agricultural credit in AP moves for reasons other than the cyclone

name: Kerala moratorium on recovery of agricultural loans after the 2018 floods
